title: Exam MCQ
prompt:
Which completes the removal correctly (remove all "x")?

```java
ArrayList<String> list = ...; // [x, b, x, x]
for (int i = list.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (list.get(i).equals("x")) { list.remove(i); }
}
```

A. Correct as written
B. Fails: needs i++ inside
C. Fails: forward loop required
D. Fails: remove(i--) required

Print the letter, then your one-sentence justification.

tests.name: A exam
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("A"), "answer must start with the correct letter");
tests.hint: A. Backward removal cannot skip: shifts only affect unvisited FORWARD indices, and none remain. B breaks the descent; C reintroduces the skip bug; D corrupts the index.
